name: Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP)
requested: chrome CDP documentation (no version given: latest)
summary: Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) tip-of-tree r1756183 (Chrome 160 dev line): every domain's methods, events and types (Page, Runtime, Network, Target, Fetch, Input, Emulation, DOM...), the V8/JS inspector protocol, HTTP discovery endpoints (/json/version, --remote-debugging-port), Protocol Monitor, chrome.debugger, FAQ, and the protocol changelog since March 2024.
license: BSD-3-Clause (protocol JSON, generated domain pages, changelog); Apache-2.0 (protocol viewer landing page)
coverage: The whole tip-of-tree protocol as published at the v0.0.1756183 tag: 53 browser-protocol domains (595 methods, 210 events, 564 types) and 6 JS/V8-inspector domains (82 methods, 22 events, 48 types), as raw JSON plus one Markdown page per domain; the protocol viewer's landing page (scope and support, Protocol Monitor, chrome.debugger, FAQ, HTTP endpoints and their security rules); the devtools-protocol README; the protocol changelog (361 entries, 2024-03 to 2026-11), split by month.
gaps: Tip-of-tree only. r1756183 is after the Chrome 159 branch point (r1739869), so it describes the Chrome 160 dev/canary line; stable Chrome lacks the newest methods. Use the changelog to see when something landed.
The 'stable 1.3' protocol (a Chrome 64 snapshot) is no longer published by the viewer (/1-3/ returns 404) and is not included.

TypeScript definitions (types/protocol.d.ts and the proxy/mapping files) and the .pdl sources are not included; they carry the same content as the JSON. Get them from the devtools-protocol npm package.

Pages linked from the landing page but hosted elsewhere are not included: 'Getting Started with CDP', the Chromium backend overview and contribution guide, developer.chrome.com DevTools/Puppeteer/ChromeDriver docs, and the chrome.debugger extension API reference.
The protocol viewer repo has no release tags; its landing page was taken from master on 2026-11-28.
Changelog entry 2025-08-13 ("ci: generate after split") keeps only its header and compare link; its diff re-added the whole protocol unchanged.
notes: Latest release chosen because no version was requested: npm devtools-protocol dist-tag latest = git tag v0.0.1756183 (the number is the Chromium revision r1756183, protocol schema version 1.3). Domain pages under api/browser-protocol and api/js-protocol are generated by tools/cdp2md.py from the unchanged JSON (the same data the viewer renders). content/index.md is the viewer's <template id="landing"> converted to Markdown with markdownify (heading anchor links removed). changelog.md was split into content/release-notes/changelog-YYYY-MM.md by roll date, without changing entries, except one: the 2025-08-13 entry "ci: generate after split (#330)" only moved the protocol into per-domain .pdl files, and its ~28,000-line diff was replaced by a note. For comparison, puppeteer-core 25.19.0 pins devtools-protocol 0.0.1724436 (Chrome 158 line).
